svg.title: Delayed fixed-pair discrimination deteriorates while the analytic signal bound ranges from loose early to sharp late.
svg.desc: The upper curves retain the original fixed-known-pair experiment: a=0.23 versus 0.77,A=1,D=0.05,sigma=0.05 and eight times shifted together. They describe only the declared delays, not universal monotonicity for arbitrary sensing schedules. The lower ratio compares the elementary odd-mode signal upper bound with the actual off-center contrast at x=0.49. Ratios well above one expose looseness; midpoint contrast is exactly zero, so its ratio is not reported. A valid bound is not automatically a useful statistical or continuous-parameter guarantee.
